note: Paraphrase-recall probe v2. Corpus: 22 single-sentence units in one file, including near-miss distractors (three budgets, two venues, two deadlines). Questions were authored keyboard-hostile ON PURPOSE for the paraphrase set (near-zero word overlap with the gold unit), so the keyword arm is expected to fail there by construction -- the probe measures whether the semantic channel closes a constructed lexical gap, not real-world query quality. n is small and the author built both the channel and the probe: read every number as fixture evidence only. Three structured memory records (catering budget, venue, registration deadline) are seeded so the production channel mix is exercised.
